replies.subject: Re: One thought on concrete and timeless exteriors
replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thanks for reaching out and for your kind words regarding the article.

We appreciate the context on My Villa. If you're interested in exploring a
potential collaboration or a feature on our site, we offer several
placement options, including guest posts and link insertions.

Let me know if you'd like to see our current rates and guidelines for
those, and we can go from there.

www.OffTheMRKT.com
www.OffTheMRKT.com


On Sun, Nov 1, 2026 at 8:03 PM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Offthemrkt team,
>
> (Writing to the Offthemrkt newsroom rather than Jeremy directly — we
> couldn't locate a direct contact. Feel free to forward if it's a
> better fit for them or the desk.)
>
> Really enjoyed your piece on timeless exterior details — you made the
> case well that concrete carries far more architectural range than its
> utilitarian reputation suggests, cast-in-place especially.
>
> A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European
> construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los
> Angeles — designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.
>
> One thought your piece sparked: in European building, exposed concrete
> has long been both the structure and the finish — durability and
> beauty in one gesture. That dual role feels like the real story.
>
> Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are
> doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>
